_comment: This package.json exists ONLY so Node treats .js files as ES
modules (matching the extension's manifest type:'module' service
worker). It declares zero dependencies — the extension is
deliberately dep-free at runtime, and tests use Node's built-in
node:test runner with no third-party libs.
The CI tripwire 'no JS deps in package.json' relies on the
dependencies + devDependencies blocks staying empty. Don't add
deps without first reviewing SECURITY.md A4 (supply-chain).
`npm run smoke` is the one script here with a dependency, and it is
NOT declared above: the harness lives in its own nested, opt-in
package (tests/smoke/package.json, gitignored install) so this file
and package-lock.json stay exactly as dep-free as the tripwire says.
name: locke-extension
